from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full uniform separator splits the two aligned masks.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and h % 2 == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and w % 2 == 1]
    if sep_rows:
        r = sep_rows[0]
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(top,bottom)]
    if sep_cols:
        c = sep_cols[0]
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a,b in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(left,right)]
    raise ValueError("separator not found")
'''
path=programs/'task-a1e9c674.py'
path.write_text(source)
